title: Jazzy Energizing Vietnamese Tomato Juice Che Ba Mau
description: Funky, crumbly, energizing Vietnamese dish featuring tomato juice, caramelized onions, and a dairy-free-friendly twist on traditional che ba mau.
instructions: In a blender, combine tomato juice, caramelized onions, coconut sugar, palm sugar, coconut cream, ginger, and lime juice.
Blend the mixture until smooth and creamy.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or a large serving dish.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cinnamon and a few slices of lime, if desired.
Optional: top with toasted coconut flakes or chopped fresh herbs for added texture and flavor.
Enjoy as a refreshing and energizing breakfast treat.
Note: You can also make this recipe ahead of time and store it in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours.
When ready to serve, give the mixture a good stir and garnish with additional lime wedges, if desired.
